We’ve been customers for years, which makes writing this review incredibly disappointing.

Over time, we’ve tried to be understanding and let a lot of things slide our dog coming home with scratches, covered in other dogs’ slobber or urine, and even having his leash put on incorrectly multiple times. We understand dogs play rough and mistakes happen.

What finally pushed us to leave a review was the lack of transparency. We were recently charged extra fees for things like additional brushing and our dog remaining in a crate after grooming, and a different grooming price without any notice or approval beforehand.

Unfortunately, this feels like another overpriced Miami business where upselling and surprise fees have become more important than customer service and transparency.

To make matters worse, gratuity % was calculated on top of these unexpected charges. As a customer, it leaves the impression that these add-on fees not only increase the bill but also increase the amount being tipped.

When we questioned the charges, we were simply told it was a “new policy” after the service was already completed. Policies should be communicated before repeat customers are billed, not after.

As dog owners, we’re paying for more than grooming/daycare we’re paying for the peace of mind that our dog is in safe/honest place. Sadly, that trust is no longer there.

I’m feeling so frustrated today. Exactly 2 years and 3 months ago, we were traveling internationally and had to leave our little dog behind because he was only 5 months old and couldn’t travel. We got a few recommendations and ended up leaving him at DogHotel in Brickell, which at the time seemed like a great choice.

It was a 10-day trip, so I paid extra for additional baths and asked if they would take good care of Teddy in case anything happened (like an accident). They reassured me, and I went on the trip. On the 7th day, I noticed they weren’t posting any photos of him like they usually do, so I asked if everything was okay. They told me Teddy had hurt his leg but that he was doing fine.

But a mother’s instinct doesn’t lie. I asked a friend to stop by and check on him — and to make a long story short: Teddy was dirty, covered in poop, and limping. My friend immediately took him to a vet, and it turned out he had TWO tibia fractures!

To sum it up, we NEVER found out what happened to him. Teddy had to get pins in his leg, and we even had to negotiate and split the payment so they would help cover the vet bill.

So why am I speaking out now, after 2 years? Because yesterday, my friend told me she took her dog there for a simple grooming, and he came back MISSING AN EYE!

I’d really like to know if anyone else has had a bad experience with this place, because it’s not fair to stay quiet about how careless they are with our animals.
